egressOwner: legacy variant: per-connection Tokio sender (RESTREAM_EGRESS_FABRIC unset). fabric variant: RtmpFabricEngine/RtmpShardBackend (RESTREAM_EGRESS_FABRIC=rtmp).
comparison: At N=10 RTMP-source outputs, fabric CPU (6.98% avg / 8.70% peak) and legacy CPU (6.82% avg / 7.77% peak) are within noise of each other -- roughly at parity, not the multi-x regression the SRT fabric showed pre-batching-fix (see egress-phase0/wsl-6cpu-12gb/w2-fabric-confirmed). RSS is essentially identical (fabric slightly lower). Both variants delivered all 10 outputs to progress within their timeout in both runs -- media correctness confirmed at this scale, not just started.
scope: This is a smoke-scale A/B (N=10, default RTMP_FABRIC_MATRIX_EGRESS_COUNT), proving the fabric path works correctly under real live-process conditions (real mediamtx receiver, real ffmpeg publisher, real restream server) and giving an early CPU/RSS read -- not the exhaustive 1,000+-output parity proof docs/egress-implementation.md Phase 5's exit gate ultimately requires before a default-mode flip. Re-run with RTMP_FABRIC_MATRIX_EGRESS_COUNT set higher (and ideally on a host provisioned for that scale) for the full proof.
deviations: Isolated lifecycle (one mediamtx+restream stack per variant, not shared); single measurement point per variant rather than a growth curve; reduced scale (10, not 1,000+) per host class, matching the same host-class caveat egress-phase0's own captures record.
